text: Carpentry is a skilled trade that involves the construction or repair of structures and objects using wood and other materials. One of the fundamental techniques used in carpentry is sanding, where rough edges or surfaces are smoothed down to make them more user-friendly and visually appealing. Sawing, on the other hand, is a critical step that involves using tools such as hand saws, circular saws, or power saws to cut wood into precise pieces. Carpentry also involves various other techniques, including joinery, which is the process of joining pieces of wood together to form a cohesive structure. By combining sanding, sawing, and joinery, carpenters can create a wide range of projects, from furniture to architectural elements.
